about_description: Eurtisan connects independent makers with buyers who value handmade quality. Built for Europe, designed for craft.
about_mission_text: We believe that craft matters. Eurtisan exists to help Europe's independent makers reach buyers who care about where their goods come from, who made them, and what they are made of. Every purchase on Eurtisan supports a real artisan and keeps traditional skills alive.
about_values_makers_text: Artisans set their own prices, own their customer relationships, and keep control of their creative work.
about_values_quality_text: We prioritise small-batch, well-made goods over mass production and disposable trends.
about_values_europe_text: From GDPR-aware design to Euro pricing and EU-wide shipping, Eurtisan is made with European buyers and sellers in mind.
about_values_sustainability_text: We encourage local fulfilment, minimal packaging, and transparent materials so that buying less can mean buying better.
about_trust_text: Eurtisan is operated from France and complies with EU consumer protection, tax, and data privacy regulations. Payments are processed by licensed providers, payouts are tracked in your dashboard, and our dispute process is designed to be fair to both buyers and sellers.

ranking_disclosure_no_payment: Sellers cannot pay to rank higher. No listing on Eurtisan is sponsored or promoted in exchange for payment.
ranking_disclosure_category_body: Products are shown in the order you choose with the sort control. By default the newest listings come first. Filters only remove products from the list; they never change the order of the ones that remain.
ranking_disclosure_search_body: When you search, results are ordered by how well they match your words, in this order of importance:
ranking_disclosure_search_1: How many of your search words a listing matches.
ranking_disclosure_search_2: How closely the words are spelled — a listing matching without typos ranks above one that needed a correction.
ranking_disclosure_search_3: How close your words appear to each other in the listing.
ranking_disclosure_search_4: Which part of the listing matched, in this order: product name, shop name, category, then description.
ranking_disclosure_search_5: The sort you chose, if you changed it from Relevance.
ranking_disclosure_search_6: Whether the match is exact rather than partial.
ranking_disclosure_search_7: Whether the product is in stock — in-stock products come first.
ranking_disclosure_search_8: The product's review score, weighted by how many reviews back it up, so a well-reviewed product outranks an unproven one.
ranking_disclosure_search_note: Spelling correction and synonyms are applied to your words, and both English and Dutch are recognised. Recency is deliberately not part of the review score — use the Newest sort for that.

review_disclosure_verified_body: Every review on Eurtisan comes from someone who bought the product here. We check this automatically, before a review can be written:
review_disclosure_check_purchase: The reviewer's account placed the order that contains the product.
review_disclosure_check_delivered: The order was marked delivered, and 14 days have passed since — so the review reflects living with the product, not unboxing it.
review_disclosure_check_once: One review per product per order, so a single purchase cannot be reviewed twice.
review_disclosure_check_own: Makers cannot review products from their own shop.
review_disclosure_order: Reviews are shown newest first by default. You can also order them by highest rating, lowest rating, or helpful marks, and filter them by star rating.
review_disclosure_dates: Each review shows the date it was published and the date the buyer received the product.
review_disclosure_moderation: We do not edit reviews. Anyone can report one, which sends it to a moderator — reporting alone changes nothing. A moderator can hide a review that is illegal or breaks our terms, and the author is always told what was decided and why.
review_disclosure_retention: We keep reviews for as long as the product is listed. If a maker removes the product, or you close your account, the review goes with it.
review_disclosure_no_payment: Nobody is paid or rewarded for writing a review, and makers cannot pay to have one removed.

privacy_section_1_text:
Eurtisan ("we", "us", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data when you use our marketplace platform at eurtisan.eu.

We process your data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable European data protection laws. By using our Platform, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this policy.
privacy_section_3_text:
We process:

- Account and Profile Data: name, email, password hash, and profile details.
- Contact Data: billing and shipping addresses and any phone number provided.
- Payment and Transaction Data: Mollie identifiers and status, orders, fulfillment, tracking, payouts, refunds, and disputes. We do not store full card numbers.
- Technical and Operational Data: server IP records, browser/device details, page paths, performance, errors, traces, and security events.
- Communications and Email Delivery Data: platform/support messages and provider delivery, bounce, block, or complaint events.

Optional browser analytics and diagnostics require consent. Necessary server telemetry, security records, transactional email events, and provider callbacks do not depend on that consent.
privacy_section_4_text:
We process personal data on the following legal bases under Article 6 GDPR:

- Contract: account operation, transaction processing, fulfillment, dispute handling, and customer support.
- Legal Obligation: tax, accounting, consumer-protection, and regulatory requirements.
- Legitimate Interests: fraud prevention, network and information security, service reliability, abuse prevention, and operational troubleshooting. We assess these interests against your rights.
- Consent: optional browser analytics and diagnostics, and marketing communications where offered. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting earlier lawful processing.
privacy_section_5_text: We use personal data to operate the marketplace; process orders, payments, shipping, refunds, and payouts; communicate about accounts and transactions; provide support and resolve disputes; detect fraud and security incidents; diagnose reliability and performance problems; comply with legal obligations; and send optional marketing only where permitted.
privacy_section_6_text:
Essential cookies and storage support authentication, sessions, carts, locale, security, and checkout.

With consent, Grafana Faro sends page paths, browser performance, errors, and traces to Eurtisan's same-origin /collect endpoint. It uses a tab-scoped sessionStorage ID, not a persistent analytics cookie; console capture is off and filters reduce sensitive data. Withdrawal pauses future sends.

Cookie-less Umami analytics are also consent-gated but disabled by production defaults. Retention and this notice must be confirmed before enablement. The preference remains in localStorage until changed or cleared. Separate operational server telemetry, email events, and authenticated provider callbacks remain active. See the Cookie Policy for controls.
privacy_section_7_text: We do not sell personal data. Data is disclosed only as needed to marketplace participants, hosting and infrastructure services, Mollie for payment activity, Sendcloud and carriers for shipping and tracking, Brevo or the configured mail transport for transactional email and delivery events, professional advisers, and legal or regulatory authorities. Eurtisan's Grafana observability stack receives browser diagnostics only after consent and receives separate operational server telemetry. Umami is disabled by production deployment defaults. We do not use advertising trackers.
privacy_section_8_text: Our providers may process personal data in the EEA or in other jurisdictions. When a transfer from the EEA is subject to Chapter V GDPR, we use the applicable transfer basis and safeguards, such as an adequacy decision or Standard Contractual Clauses, and assess supplementary measures where required. Contact us for information relevant to your data.
privacy_section_9_text:
Retention depends on purpose and law:

- Active account data: until closure, then deleted or anonymized except required records.
- Orders and invoices: 10 years.
- Application and consented Faro logs/errors: 30 days; browser/server traces: 7 days; operational metrics: 15 days.
- Email send logs: 90 days; terminal outbox rows: 7 days; Brevo and Sendcloud webhook events: 30 days.
- Analytics preference: until changed or browser storage is cleared; Faro ID: one tab session; marketing preference: until withdrawn.
- Disputes, returns, and financial reconciliation: the applicable consumer-protection, accounting, fraud-prevention, or limitation period.
- Guest-order access tokens: 24 hours or until the order is claimed by a verified account; raw tokens are not stored.

Umami is disabled by production defaults. Its retention must be confirmed before enablement.
privacy_section_10_text:
Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

- Right to Access: request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
- Right to Rectification: request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
- Right to Erasure: request deletion of your data in certain circumstances ("right to be forgotten").
- Right to Restriction: request limitation of processing in specific situations.
- Right to Data Portability: receive your data in a structured, commonly used format and transfer it to another controller.
- Right to Object: object to processing based on legitimate interests or direct marketing.
- Right to Withdraw Consent: withdraw consent at any time for processing based on consent.

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at {email}. We will respond within one month of receiving your request.
privacy_section_11_text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include encryption of data in transit and at rest, access controls, regular security assessments, and staff training. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your data, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
privacy_section_12_text: Our Platform is not intended for children under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect or process personal data from children under 16. If you believe we have inadvertently collected such data, please contact us immediately and we will take steps to delete it.
privacy_section_13_text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, legal requirements, or platform features. Material changes will be notified to you via email or a prominent notice on the Platform prior to the change becoming effective. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacy_section_14_text:
If you have any questions, concerns, or complaints about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at {email}.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the data protection supervisory authority in your EU Member State of residence if you believe that our processing of your personal data infringes the GDPR.
terms_section_1_text:
These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the Eurtisan marketplace platform ("Platform"), operated by {name}. By creating an account, accessing, or using the Platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, you must not use the Platform.

We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. Material changes will be notified via email or a platform notice. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.
terms_section_2_text:
For the purposes of these Terms:

- "Platform" means the Eurtisan website, applications, and related services.
- "Buyer" means a user who purchases products through the Platform.
- "Seller" or "Creator" means a user who lists, offers, and sells products through the Platform.
- "Order" means a transaction between a Buyer and Seller facilitated by the Platform.
- "Content" means any text, images, listings, reviews, or other material submitted to the Platform.
terms_section_3_text:
To use certain features of the Platform, you must register for an account. You must be at least 18 years old and capable of entering into legally binding contracts. You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration and to keep it updated.

You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.
terms_section_4_text:
Eurtisan operates as an online marketplace that connects independent Sellers with Buyers. We are not a party to transactions between users. We do not own, manufacture, sell, or resell any products listed on the Platform. We do not guarantee the quality, safety, or legality of items listed, nor the truth or accuracy of listings.

Sellers are independent contractors and not employees, agents, or affiliates of Eurtisan.
terms_section_5_text:
As a Buyer, you agree to:

- Provide accurate shipping and billing information.
- Pay for all orders placed through the Platform in accordance with the listed prices and applicable fees.
- Review Seller policies, including shipping and return terms, before making a purchase.
- Communicate respectfully with Sellers and use the Platform only for lawful purposes.
- Acknowledge that product descriptions and images are provided by Sellers, not Eurtisan.
terms_section_6_text:
As a Seller, you agree to:

- Be at least 18 years old and have the legal right to sell listed products.
- Provide accurate, complete, and non-misleading listings, prices, shipping promises, trader information, and policies.
- Comply with consumer protection, product safety, tax, intellectual-property, and other applicable laws.
- Fulfill orders within the stated processing and delivery timeframes and communicate delays.
- Respond promptly and in good faith to statutory requests, buyer enquiries, and disputes.
- Maintain required licences, registrations, and insurance.
terms_section_7_text:
Payments on the Platform are processed by our third-party payment provider, Mollie B.V. Eurtisan does not store full payment card details. By making a purchase, you authorize us and Mollie to charge the applicable amount.

Eurtisan may charge platform fees, commissions, or transaction fees on sales, which will be clearly disclosed to Sellers. Payouts to Sellers are subject to verification, processing times, and minimum thresholds as specified in the Seller dashboard.

All prices are displayed in Euro (EUR) unless otherwise stated. Buyers are responsible for any applicable taxes, duties, or customs fees.
terms_section_8_text:
Sellers set shipping methods, costs, processing periods, and delivery estimates and must state them accurately. Sellers remain responsible for their fulfillment and mandatory consumer-law obligations; Eurtisan does not become the seller merely by providing marketplace, payment, shipping, or dispute tools.

For trader-to-consumer sales, risk generally remains with the Seller until the Buyer or a person designated by the Buyer takes physical possession, except where applicable law provides otherwise for a carrier independently chosen by the Buyer. Nothing in these Terms limits mandatory remedies for delay, non-delivery, loss, or transit damage.
terms_section_9_text:
Seller policies cannot limit mandatory consumer rights. Our configurable baseline allows an eligible withdrawal within 14 days after delivery; personalised, made-to-order, perishable, unsealed hygiene, or other legally excluded goods may not qualify.

Use the return action in each seller shipment. Buyers fund direct return shipping for a discretionary withdrawal; sellers fund reasonable return shipping for defective or incorrect goods. A complete eligible return includes the standard outbound shipping cost. Refunds begin after receipt or accepted shipping evidence. Product eligibility and policy version are snapshotted when you buy.

Disputes cover unresolved order problems, including eligible non-delivery. Opening one does not issue a refund or reverse funds; only an authorised resolution starts refund and payout action.
terms_section_10_text:
Sellers retain all ownership rights to their products, listings, and related content. By submitting Content to the Platform, you grant Eurtisan a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, display, reproduce, and distribute your Content solely for the purpose of operating and promoting the Platform.

Buyers receive only the rights explicitly granted by the Seller upon purchase of a product. You may not copy, modify, distribute, or create derivative works from Platform Content without authorization.
terms_section_11_text:
You may not use the Platform to:

- List or sell counterfeit, stolen, illegal, or dangerous goods.
- List or sell food, drink, or any other product intended for consumption. Eurtisan is not set up to carry the ingredient, allergen, and origin information that EU food law requires listings to show before a purchase is made.
- Harass, threaten, or discriminate against other users.
- Circumvent or attempt to circumvent Platform fees or policies.
- Engage in fraudulent activities, including payment fraud or chargeback abuse.
- Upload malicious code, viruses, or interfere with Platform security.
- Infringe intellectual property rights or violate any applicable law.
- Collect or harvest personal data of other users without consent.
terms_section_12_text:
We encourage Buyers and Sellers to resolve disputes directly and amicably. Eurtisan provides an internal dispute resolution process that may be used to escalate unresolved issues. However, we are under no obligation to mediate disputes and assume no liability for the outcome.

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts involved in repeated disputes, fraud, or violations of these Terms. Nothing in this section prevents you from seeking remedies through the courts.
terms_section_13_text:
To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Eurtisan's total liability arising out of or in connection with these Terms or your use of the Platform shall be limited to the total amount of fees paid by you to Eurtisan in the 12 months preceding the event giving rise to liability.

We are not liable for: indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages; loss of profits, revenue, data, or goodwill; disputes between Buyers and Sellers; or issues arising from third-party services, including payment processing and shipping carriers.
terms_section_14_text:
You may close your account at any time through your account settings or by contacting us. We may suspend or terminate your account, with or without notice, for violations of these Terms, applicable law, or conduct that we determine to be harmful to the Platform or other users.

Upon termination, your right to use the Platform ceases immediately. Provisions regarding liability, intellectual property, dispute resolution, and governing law survive termination. Unresolved Orders and financial obligations must be fulfilled even after account closure.
terms_section_15_text:
These Terms are governed by the laws of {country} and the European Union, without regard to conflict of law principles. Any dispute arising from these Terms or your use of the Platform shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of {country}.

If you are a consumer resident in the European Union, you may also bring proceedings in the courts of your country of residence. Mandatory consumer protection provisions in your jurisdiction shall not be affected.
terms_section_16_text: For questions about these Terms, please contact us at {email}.
cookies_section_1_text: Eurtisan uses cookies and browser storage for essential functions. Optional browser analytics and diagnostics require your affirmative choice.
cookies_section_2_text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile) when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work efficiently, provide a better user experience, and give information to website owners. Similar technologies include local storage, session storage, and pixel tags.
cookies_section_3_text: Essential technologies support sessions, carts, locale, security, and checkout and cannot be disabled by the analytics control. Mollie may use technology needed for an initiated payment. We use no advertising cookies.
cookies_section_4_text: With consent, Grafana Faro sends performance, page-path, error, and trace signals to Eurtisan's same-origin collector. Its ID is tab-scoped in sessionStorage; the preference is in localStorage. Umami is cookie-less, consent-gated, and disabled by production defaults. Optional collection does not load or send before consent and stops after rejection or withdrawal.
cookies_section_5_text: Mollie may use technology needed for an initiated payment. Carrier tracking pages may apply their own policies when opened. These provider interactions are separate from Eurtisan's analytics control.
cookies_section_6_text: Use this page to accept, reject, or withdraw optional collection. Withdrawal pauses Faro and future Umami calls but does not erase earlier lawful signals; the Privacy Policy retention schedule applies. Browser settings can clear storage. Blocking essential technology may break sign-in, carts, locale, security, or checkout.
cookies_section_7_text: We may update this Cookie Policy to reflect changes in technology, regulation, or our practices. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
cookies_section_8_text: If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at {email}.
